rollback_evidence: Measured on vJunos-switch 26.2R1.7 without a BGP license and with a local AS configured: a neighbor was created with its group in one batch, and a second neighbor with its own peer AS was created on that group, read back by the check account in the neighbor display (group, routing instance and state Idle) and undone; each undo restored the configuration (SHA-256 before and after matched). The key is group@address. The neighbor owns its optional peer AS and ordered policy overrides.
